pairs.l: 1 — Don't forget to stop at the grocery. Friends are coming over.
2 — Found amazing phone online. How can I convince mum the Internet is safe?
3 — I should've answered sooner. Call me on my cell phone. My bad.
4 — I lost my phone charger. Parents can't find out. Keep it secret!
5 — You and Mark must make up before the wedding this Saturday.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (stani u dućan, dolaze prijatelji) = D (Do the shopping). Poruka 2 (treba savjet kako uvjeriti mamu) = F (I need some advice). Poruka 3 (trebao sam ranije odgovoriti, oprosti) = A (I apologise). Poruka 4 (nitko ne smije znati za izgubljeni punjač) = E (Don't tell anyone). Poruka 5 (ti i Mark se morate pomiriti) = C (Work it out).

r6.exp: 'A nice change from all the MILITARY stuff' = odmor od vojnih eksponata = A (To take a break from viewing weapons).

r7.exp: 'Bands were ADDING ELEMENTS FROM OTHER MUSIC STYLES' = eksperimentiranje s različitim žanrovima = C.

r8.exp: 'Worth every penny. We didn't mind paying full price.' = cijena je bila prihvatljiva = C (acceptable).

r9.exp: Stella (Miina prijateljica) odlazi s Miinim bratićem → Miina prijateljica odlazi = B (Because her friend is going away).

r10.exp: 'She doesn't talk much' = šutljiva = A (Quiet). Max ne zna koliko je marljiva, i ona nije uplašena — Max je bio zabrinut.

r11.exp: 'The full week was needed for TECHNICAL DETAILS and for MEMORISING SCRIPTS' → glumci i ekipa trebali tjedan za pripremu = B.

r12.exp: 'At the kitchen table everyone had a place to GATHER and a reason to be there' → svi se skupljaju za stolom = B.

r13.exp: 'Didn't manage to MATCH the number of sets Lucy used' → I Love Lucy je imala najviše setova = A.

r14.exp: 'Introduced real-world events, addressing SOCIAL ISSUES' → svakodnevni problemi i teme = C.

r15.exp: 'Focusing on camera work and editing' = više pažnje na tehničkim detaljima = C.

r16.exp: 'Low self-confidence (16)____. As a society we are surrounded by unrealistic concepts of what we should look like.' → C: if a lot of attention is focused on appearance.

r17.exp: 'Don't see in the mirror the body (17)____.' → F: that is staring at them from magazine covers or YouTube. Tijelo s naslovnica časopisa i YouTubea.

r18.exp: 'Low self-confidence (18)____, OR they may set unrealistic expectations.' → E: because they believe their schoolwork is too challenging. Dvije alternativne uzroke.

r19.exp: 'Focus on other skills or positive qualities (19)____.' → B: that go far beyond academic success. Vještine koje nadilaze akademski uspjeh.

r20.exp: 'Help them feel (20)____.' → D: as if they have worth and value outside of the classroom. Naglašavanjem pozitivnih osobina učenici osjećaju svoju vrijednost.

r21.exp: 'The two cousins, WHO regularly got into trouble' — relativna zamjenica 'who' za osobe (ne-restriktivna surečenica uz zarez).

r22.exp: 'When TOLD OFF for getting wet' — frazalni glagol: tell off = izgrditi, prekoriti. Pasivni oblik gerunda.

r23.exp: 'Small creatures LIKE fairies' = sitna bića poput vila. 'Like' = sličan, poput (prijedlog usporedbe).

r24.exp: 'Suspicion grew OVER time' — prijedlog 'over' za protok vremena: over time = s vremenom.

r25.exp: 'Arthur's instincts were right, ALTHOUGH it would be decades before confirmed.' — 'although' = iako (kontrast: bio je u pravu, ali potvrda je kasnila).

r26.exp: 'Stands OUT as the most beautiful river' — frazalni glagol: stand out = isticati se, biti poseban.

r27.exp: 'Known FOR its magnificent rivers' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: known for = poznat po.

r28.exp: 'Comes FROM several factors' — fiksni prijedlog: come from = potječe od, dolazi od.

r29.exp: 'Water plants STRENGTHEN its bright green appearance' — biljke pojačavaju zelenu boju. 'Strengthen' = pojačati, učvrstiti.

r30.exp: 'Trees ALONG its path' = drveće duž puta rijeke. Prijedlog 'along' = duž, uz.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) prednosti življenja u stranoj zemlji, (2) najveći problem i zašto, (3) što si propuštao/la od doma i zašto. Dužina 80–100 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (80–100 riječi).
